learn.text:
Today our papa
 Is searching everywhere,
 He has lost his spectacles,
 It was his only pair!

 He can’t read the newspaper,
 He can’t watch TV,
 He can’t cut the vegetables,
 Oh! Where can it be?

 He checked inside his pockets,
 He glanced under his chair,
 He searched near the window,
 He looked everywhere.

 I told him, “Stop, Papa!”
 I went up close, and said!
 “Papa, your spectacles
 Are right there on your head!”

                           1     Papa’s Spectacles

                       Let us Recite
                                         Today our papa
                                   Is searching everywhere,
                                  He has lost his spectacles,
                                      It was his only pair!


                                 He can’t read the newspaper,
                                      He can’t watch TV,
                                 He can’t cut the vegetables,
                                     Oh! Where can it be?


                                He checked inside his pockets,
                                 He glanced under his chair,
                                He searched near the window,
                                    He looked everywhere.


                                   I told him, “Stop, Papa!”
                                  I went up close, and said!
                                    “Papa, your spectacles
                                Are right there on your head!”

                      Let us Speak
                   ‘Papa’ is a commonly used word in English to address
                   one’s ‘father’. Say aloud the word you use for ‘father’
                   in your language. Make a list of such words in your
                   notebook. Share them with the class.
